description: This file contains service functions for managing Evaluator entities, including CRUD operations, within a Node.js backend using TypeORM and Express.

methods.name: getAllEvaluators
methods.description: Fetches all evaluators for a given workspace, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getEvaluator
methods.description: Retrieves a specific evaluator by ID within a workspace.

methods.name: createEvaluator
methods.description: Creates a new evaluator from provided data.

methods.name: updateEvaluator
methods.description: Updates an existing evaluator identified by ID within a workspace.

methods.name: deleteEvaluator
methods.description: Deletes an evaluator by ID within a workspace.
